events.event: Students from many campuses and civil-society groups (Komite Selamatkan Daulat Rakyat/SADAR, #IndonesiaSadar, BEM UI/Undip/Brawijaya) rally at Bundaran HI and Patung Kuda in Jakarta on Sumpah Pemuda day with five demands to Prabowo and Gibran, and disperse around 19:45 WIB.
events.key_numbers: 53 demonstrations in DKI Jakarta on 28 Oct (Polda Metro Jaya) · 24 other community activities · 5 demands: national disaster status for karhutla, APBN for public interest (end MBG/KDMP spending), lower education costs, eradicate KKN, end militarisation of civilian spaces · 4 protesters in white shirts seen detained · thousands of police/TNI deployed (no exact figure) · rally started 14:00 WIB, dispersed ~19:45 WIB
events.why_it_matters: The biggest street protest in weeks puts haze, free meals and corruption on one list of student demands, and it hit Sudirman-Thamrin traffic.
events.spreading_evidence: detik terpopuler: at least 5 of top 20 headlines (Bundaran HI, Kapolda, hujan deras, jalan ditutup, massa bubar) on 28 Oct evening

events.event: KPK searches the offices of PT Djarum and the Kudus Bea Cukai office (KPPBC Madya Kudus) over suspected kickbacks for excise stamps (pita cukai), seizing documents and electronic evidence under a general investigation order with no suspect named yet.
events.key_numbers: Sprindik umum, 0 suspects named · follow-up to Feb 2026 Customs sting that named 7 suspects · 3 active investigation orders · prosecutors demand 11.5 yrs (Rizal), 10 yrs (Sisprian Subiaksono), 7.5 yrs (Orlando Hamonangan) for three Bea Cukai officials · Blueray Cargo trio sentenced 3 yrs / 2.5 yrs / 2.5 yrs
events.why_it_matters: Cigarette excise is a huge state revenue stream and Djarum is a household name, so a probe into stamp bribery touches both state money and a major brand.
events.spreading_evidence: detik terpopuler: two headlines in top 20 (items 4 and 14) on 28 Oct evening; also CNBC and CNN coverage

events.event: KPK searches the Klaten PUPR office in the case of Bupati Hamenang Wajar Ismoyo, seizing cash and documents, as detik highlights a 'record' of regional-head corruption cases in Central Java.
events.key_numbers: Cash and electronic evidence seized (amount not verified) · detik headline: 'Rekor Baru Korupsi Kepala Daerah di Jawa Tengah' (top of detik terpopuler)
events.why_it_matters: Shows how often Central Java regional heads have been caught in project-procurement corruption.
events.spreading_evidence: detik terpopuler #1 ('Rekor Baru Korupsi Kepala Daerah di Jawa Tengah') and item 18, 28 Oct evening

events.event: PKS Secretary-General Muhammad Kholid confirms he recently spoke with PDIP Secretary-General Hasto Kristiyanto about the Gibran diploma controversy, while the PKS faction's stance in the DPR remains undecided.
events.key_numbers: No formal DPR motion or vote yet · Hasto cites MK Decision No. 90/2023 · NasDem says no order yet from its chair
events.why_it_matters: Two parties on opposite sides of Prabowo's coalition talking about the vice president's diploma is a political signal, not just legal noise.

events.event: Prosecutors will call former President Jokowi and his aide AKBP Syarif Muhammad Fitriansyah as witnesses at the 5 November hearing of Roy Suryo, charged with defaming Jokowi over his diploma, at the East Jakarta District Court.
events.key_numbers: Hearing 5 Nov 2026 · Jokowi listed as first witness · charges under KUHP Art 433(1) jo 441(1) and ITE Law Art 35 / Art 32 · hearing postponed to share a day with the 'Tifa' case
events.why_it_matters: Jokowi testifying in a diploma-defamation trial would be a high-profile moment in the whole 'ijazah' saga.

events.event: Forest-fire hotspots keep falling: the Forestry Ministry reports 79 national high-confidence hotspots (down from 93), with the six priority provinces at zero, while BNPB counts Papua burned area at 2,393 ha.
events.key_numbers: 79 hotspots on 27 Oct 21:00 WIB vs 93 the day before · 6 priority provinces (Kalbar, Kalteng, Sumsel, Jambi, Kalsel, Riau) at 0 vs 10 the day before · Kalimantan still ~1,566 ha burning, Sumatra 23 ha (BNPB) · Papua 2,393 ha burned, 73 hotspots (Papua Barat Daya 2,131 ha, Papua Selatan 161 ha, Papua Tengah 100 ha) · Kemenhub: 3,030 flights disrupted 14 Aug-25 Oct
events.why_it_matters: The haze crisis that closed schools and flights is easing on satellite data, but the ministry warns zero hotspots does not mean fires are out.
events.spreading_evidence: detik terpopuler item 20 (karhutla/banjir Kalsel); widely covered by several outlets

events.event: As the rainy transition begins, BNPB reports floods across Aceh and North Sumatra (and a Dairi landslide) plus Banjar in South Kalimantan, even as fires persist elsewhere.
events.key_numbers: Labuhanbatu 2,600 residents · Subulussalam 2,345 · Asahan 2,025 · Deli Serdang 730 · Banjar (Kalsel) 175 · Kalsel karhutla alert extended to 30 Nov · BMKG: thunderstorms in Kalsel until 3 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Indonesia is being hit by fire and flood at the same time, a visual contrast for the dry-to-wet season shift.
events.spreading_evidence: detik terpopuler item 20 ('Selain Karhutla, Banjir Juga Terjadi di Kalimantan Selatan')

events.event: National PIHPS prices on 28 Oct show red curly chilli at Rp92,800/kg and bird's-eye chilli near Rp100,000/kg, with shallots up and premium rice and beef slightly down.
events.key_numbers: Cabai merah keriting Rp81,750 -> Rp92,800/kg · cabai rawit merah Rp94,700 -> Rp97,450 (Okezone: Rp100,350 on its measure) · bawang merah Rp36,400 -> Rp39,450 · beras Super I Rp18,300 -> Rp18,000 · beras Medium I Rp16,950 -> Rp17,100 · daging sapi kualitas 1 Rp153,550 -> Rp149,300 · minyak goreng curah Rp19,750
events.why_it_matters: Chilli and shallots are in almost every Indonesian kitchen, so a 13 percent one-day jump in curly chilli shows up in household spending fast.

events.event: ANTARA rates as hoax a Facebook post showing a supposed new Rp1 million Bank Indonesia note featuring eight presidents; BI lists no note above Rp100,000 and an AI detector rated the image 99.9% likely AI-generated.
events.key_numbers: Rp1,000,000 fake note · BI denominations only Rp1,000-Rp100,000 · Hive Moderation 99.9% AI-generated
events.why_it_matters: AI-made money images circulating as 'new banknotes' are a fresh type of hoax that can trick ordinary users.

events.event: An online taxi driver is found dead inside his car near MRT Lebak Bulus station, Jakarta, and a Polda Metro raid on the Kampung Berland drug den arrests 8 people; both reached detik's most-read list.
events.key_numbers: 8 arrested (Kampung Berland) · taxi driver death cause not reported in headline
events.why_it_matters: Crime items trend, but details are thin and only the headline was seen.
events.spreading_evidence: detik terpopuler items 8 and 17, 28 Oct evening
